insights.body: For All App, App Total New Subs in US is +6.6% while all countries together are +13.8% — a gap of -7.2pp. US is about 41% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Next period outlook — Expect App Total Revenue to recover in about 7 days — more of the people installing are subscribing, mostly YMK.
insights.body: App Total New Subs is +13.8% while App Total Install is only -22.7% — a bigger share of people who installed are subscribing than usual (+36.5pp more growth). New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So expect App Total Revenue to go up in about 7 days. App Total Revenue is -14.0% right now, so this points to a recovery rather than more weakness. Most of the increase comes from YMK (+41.4%); YCP is -19.0%.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YCP is turning installs into New Subs better than usual (-19.0% vs Install -96.4%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCP New Subs -19.0% vs Install -96.4% (better than its installs); YMK New Subs +41.4% vs Install +20.9% (better than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.
